rows: 1. Boundary
Selected 100 MW / 400 MWh usable-AC outdoor LFP, 450MWh DC, $109.8M fixed 2024 physical value
Engineering reference, not an observed fleet or appraisal. Autonomous failures, BI/performance and external collector/export are outside.
2. Failure units
Integrated enclosure and separate PCS
Cell/rack independence and unit-MV/civil curves are not invented.
3. Y-axis
Same-unit conditional mean physical repair/replacement cost divided by same-unit hardware value
Safety isolation, ignition, availability and revenue are different endpoints.
4. Value rows
Ten rows reconcile: $109.8M retained and $23.4M outside
Mixed physical rows stay explicit.
5. Allocation
80×$1.05M enclosure +20×$520k PCS =$94.4M candidate hardware
$15.4M residual stays unbound; no renormalization to full TIV or repeated internals.
6. Site exposure
Declared local FSim class; no blanket mitigation or exposed-share default
Native source support and a declared common-event law are locally qualified; actual yard thermal transfer and event-resolved footprints remain uncalibrated.
7. Conditional response
Conditional scalar means with independent source/cost controls
Annual use requires the machine-readable consumer gates; full-property loss stays withheld.

sampling_notes: Each record looked up through the cell's reference evaluator (wildfire_bess_curve_eval.py) at the exact states 0–6; marks only, since the evaluator rejects any state between two classes (confirmed on every record).

Known answers replayed through evaluate_damage_call with selector_id BESS_LFP_R1_WILDFIRE_ORDINAL_V1 and each unit's value from the pinned value binding; the two repair hypotheses carry the explicit serviceability counterfactual the contract requires. Tolerances 1e-12 on the damage ratio and 1e-06 USD (the cell declares none); each answer equals the drawn mark at its state.
BESS_MV_AND_SHARED_ELECTRICAL, BESS_CIVIL, BESS_FIELDWORK confirmed withheld with the artifact's reason codes.
